about: Style library from the user's Pinterest (style-lab/pinterest-v1: 289 pins, OpenCLIP clusters, palettes.json). One film picks ONE ink set and two to four families; every family prints with that ink set, only the process changes. Rules and their reasons: DESIGN-harmony.md. A family dresses the packaging parts of the director's cards (roles); only metaphor shots get a whole drawn or 3D plate. Evidence is never restyled beyond grade and highlight.

showa.name: 昭和三色
showa.mood: culture, business stories, East Asian history

night-screen.name: 夜屏
night-screen.mood: AI, computing, the future; dark base

riso-pink.name: 粉蓝套印
riso-pink.mood: light topics, youth culture, consumer products

xerox-halftone.name: 黑白网点海报
xerox-halftone.look: one bold object or head in coarse black halftone on paper, a slogan in heavy condensed type, tiny mono captions in the corners

type.display: heavy condensed sans, all caps for Latin

xerox-halftone.avoid: more than one ink besides black; soft gradients

riso-two-ink.name: 双色套印
riso-two-ink.look: a real or modelled object printed in two screened inks, slightly off register; flat paper around it
riso-two-ink.avoid: on screenshots and readable pages (dots eat text)

showa-poster.name: 昭和丝网海报
showa-poster.look: one strong central figure in flat screen-print colour, big vertical Chinese type, a thin rule and small caption block
showa-poster.avoid: two in a row (it is a chapter mark, not body); photo-real lighting

bitmap-screen.name: 像素抖动屏
bitmap-screen.look: 1-bit dithered image in the light ink on the dark base (the old Mac look); the accent only for small marks and readouts; old OS window chrome drawn in code
bitmap-screen.avoid: faces of real people at small size (dither breaks them); long Chinese text in pixel fonts

retro-future.name: 复古未来空间
retro-future.look: a quiet surreal space (grid floor, arch, old computer in a landscape), one small figure, cold light; few flat value bands
retro-future.avoid: busy scenes; more than one subject

flat-surreal.name: 迷幻平涂插画
flat-surreal.look: a flat illustrated metaphor with a stippled texture, framed by a thin border; strong outline shapes
flat-surreal.avoid: for facts (it is clearly drawn); more than once a chapter

matte-surreal.name: 哑光超现实 3D
matte-surreal.look: a real-looking 3D scene photographed on film: matte plaster, concrete or stone with surface wear, soft daylight and long shadows, a vast calm space, one tiny human figure for scale, one accent colour only on one surface
matte-surreal.avoid: glossy CG, plastic, neon, bloom, sci-fi glow, busy detail; text in the image

type.display: heavy serif in the empty sky or ground the plate leaves free

chrome-object.name: 铬金属物件
chrome-object.look: a product photograph of a polished chrome object with real studio reflections, dust and film grain on a plain seamless background
chrome-object.avoid: rainbow holographic gradients, neon, toy-like plastic shine; more than one per chapter

roles.about: What a style may change in each director category (style-lab/reference-hupo/DIRECTOR-GRAMMAR.md). The director picks the category and the card; the style only changes the look of the card's packaging parts. Evidence stays real; a whole drawn frame is only for metaphor.

PT.name: 口播 + 叠加
PT.hupo: scanned paper tags with a red keyword; aged paper side card with a gold halftone prop; left/right poster cards; brushed-metal product card

T.name: 大字
T.hupo: bone-white 3D metal letters over the presenter or real b-roll, crossing the cut
T.keep: the plate under it is real (presenter or footage)

EN.name: 新闻 / 网页
EN.hupo: the real page, push to the sentence, black reverse highlight; numbers typed out

ED.name: 数据
ED.hupo: real ticker table; paper data collage (logos + big numbers); spec tables beside a dark product render

EP.name: 人物
EP.hupo: real photos, fast cuts with torn-paper / scan transitions; nameplate

B.name: 空镜
B.hupo: real stock footage; one motif (dollars) six times

D.name: 原理图
D.hupo: one plane, parts added step by step (3D mechanism)

C.name: 聊天
C.hupo: chat bubbles one by one, push in on the last

Q.name: 原话
Q.hupo: big black-and-white portrait, heavy serif quote

R.name: 回顾
R.hupo: big words over footage used before

M.name: 隐喻
M.hupo: none in this film (0 drawn frames)
M.note: the only category where a whole drawn or 3D plate may fill the frame
